headline: Names the Postal Service building at 1301 Alabama Avenue in Selma, Alabama, after civil rights leader Amelia Boynton Robinson.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility in Selma, Alabama, as the Amelia Boynton Robinson Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. The name honors Amelia Boynton Robinson, a civil rights leader from Selma.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
